en: Thirty-five years, I've been a detective. And for most of it, I've been after this one perp.
Catching him came to be my purpose in life.
Thirty-five years? That's a long time.
You bet. I knew his habits so well, I could predict his next heist to the day.
So on one of those days, I tailed him. I was sure it was finally going to happen... I was going to catch him red-handed.
But right before my eyes, the unthinkable happened.
The unthinkable?
Yeah. The bastard went somewhere I could never get him.
(He had everything riding on this, seriously?)
I was this close to fulfilling my dream. But after 35 years, it just... slipped through my fingers.
Now here I am, facing retirement. My career's going to end without me ever accomplishing a damn thing.
So, you get it now? Don't bother this loser for sobbing into a drink. It's all I have.
Araseki-han, was it?
Araseki-han, tell me this. If you coulda caught that one perp, would ya really all of a sudden be satisfied with your whole career?
Damn right! Something wrong with that?
...So petty.
What did you say!?
What the hell do you know? I banked everything on nailing that bastard!
Obviously, you're not a man of ambition. If you were, you'd understand what it feels like to have your dream crushed!
My dream...
Yeah. Your dream.
I have one.
My dream is to work with my brother, and together make the Tojo Clan strong again.
...Uh, that <Italic>was</Italic> my dream. But not now...
See, uh, that Tojo Clan I mentioned, it's a neighborhood baseball club. We used to be really good, y'know?
Oh, good. He's asleep.
This is a problem. I have to close up soon.
I'll take him outta here and find 'im a taxi.
Oh, thank you. That is very helpful of you.
No problem. C'mon, Araseki-han, time to go.
Nng... Wha...?
You, uh, you are...
Forgetting your phone.
No, got mine on me. Must be someone else's.
Oh. Yeah, it probably belongs to someone who got too drunk... That's just such a careless thing to do, you know? *hic*
Somebody will steal it. Bad people are all over the place, you know. Not all of them get caught, that's for sure. *hic*
Sounds like you're well into the bottle yourself.
Huh? Well... it doesn't matter if a loser like me gets careless. Nobody would give a shit.
Shit... this is what it's all come to. *hic*
Hey, barkeep, hit me with another.
Araseki-san, maybe that's enough...
Oh, come on now. You'd want to drink, too, if you were me.
It's too much. It's not good for you.
Not to worry, my man. The next one's it. Last one, I swear.
You promise? Okay, just one more.
Myyy hero! You are a cham-peee-yon! That's why you're on that side of the bar... and a loser like me's getting tipsy on this side!
(The man's way past tipsy. Best to stay away.)
Sorry I got you involved in this.
Not to worry. You alright now?
Good. I'll be leavin'.
Wait a moment. Please.
(The hell's he want?)
What you said...  It woke me up. I swear, it was like a kick to the head.
There's no guarantee of success. But you still have to try. Because only those who work hard even have a chance.
I blamed the perp for taking away my purpose. But it was me, not him, who decided there was nothing else I could possibly do in life.
Araseki-han...
If only I had realized this sooner! Now, retirement is bearing down on me. I don't have time to make a new dream come true.
What are ya sayin'? You're a great detective.
Soon as ya heard that woman screamin', you took off like a shot and caught the guy, even though you were stumblin' drunk.
That was... just instinct. There was a crime happening right before my eyes. I couldn't stand there and do nothing.
Ya helped someone in trouble. Ain't that the essence of detective work?
Chasin' your perp for all those years... Was it really just about catchin' the biggest fish in the sea? Or was it about protectin' people from criminals?
Just 'cause ya lost the dream of arrestin' one criminal, it don't take away the bigger dream of protectin' this town.
Ya still got plenty of work to do.
...You're right. Absolutely right. Somewhere along this hunting path I've walked for so many years... I lost sight of my true quarry.
Maybe if my perp had been even more dangerous, I wouldn't have lost my way so badly...
What was he like?
Oshima's his name, AKA Businessman Heihachiro.
That's...!
(He means old man Oshima from prison!)
Ah, I see you've heard of him.
The legendary thief? With over 15,000 counts of theft and no arrests?
Yep, that's right. If you believe the rumors.
You don't think they're true?
No, think about it. To pull off 15,000 thefts, that would take over forty years of doing one job a day. It's ridiculous.
Then where'd the rumors come from?
Well, he was what you might call a gentleman thief. He'd only steal from other crooks.
Businessman Heihachiro was a gentleman thief?
He'd steal mainly from politicians and bureaucrats, all of them with shady reputations.
There's even proof. Not one of them filed a report about the thefts, because it would've exposed their own corruption.
But of course, they weren't just going to take the hit, either. They used their considerable influence to demand the capture of Big Bad Businessman Heihachiro.
And that's how they turned the gentleman thief into Public Enemy Number One.
Heihachiro's identity has been known for a long time, actually. But he's a genius at not leaving a shred of evidence that could be used against him.
Since we couldn't nab him on that front, we wanted to get him on other charges, but he was squeaky clean.
So, the higher-ups prodded Heihachiro's employer into firing him.
They figured if he lost his job, he'd have to pull some petty jobs to stay afloat.
So he really was a workin' stiff, wearin' a suit and tie?
Sure was. And he couldn't tell his wife why he got fired. He kept it from her for over thirty years.
What a fool. He wasted his life trying to stick it to the man⑬ended up with nothing to his name but infamy and disgrace.
(I shared a damn cell with 'im for over a year, and didn't suspect a thing. He played the part of a reg'lar old man perfectly.)
Whatever the case, a crime's still a crime. His victims may have been shady, but they're still citizens, protected by the law.
So I felt it my duty, as a detective, to pursue him. He'd threatened the town's peace. To put him behind bars, to me, would be justice.
A thief who sacrificed his own honor for justice, and a detective who was pursuin' justice on behalf of thieves...
Years passed, until that fateful day three years ago. Maybe he knew I was tailing him. It doesn't matter now.
I watched him head to the police station, wearing his usual suit.
He turned himself in?
I couldn't believe it. There he was, in police custody. This was supposed to be the moment I'd been waiting 35 years for.
But you see? He went where I could never collar him...
(Sure, but he still got collared, didn't he?)
Where was my justice? Where was the meaning in my thirty-five years?
I was crushed, seeing how pointless it all was. How little my life meant. That's when I took to the bottle.
But that changes today. You slapped me awake.
I'm here to do more than just catch Heihachiro.
I'm here to uphold the justice I believe in and protect people.
So I'll keep being a detective, and I'll keep fighting evil. Like those purse-snatchers.
There you go. Now you got the look of the other detectives I've known. A look of conviction.
Is that so? Thanks.
Heh. Didn't think I'd get a pep talk from an escaped convict.
What!? Ya knew?
I might be a drunk, but I'm still a cop. You think I wouldn't recognize a wanted man?
And you're not arrestin' me?
What, are you stupid? I radioed the station a short while ago. If you don't start running now, you're going to find yourself surrounded by uniforms.
...You gotta start bluffin' better than that.
Heh, the next time I see you, you'll be in cuffs faster than you can blink. I'm still a detective, and you're still a criminal.
Alright. 'Preciate it.
*pant* *pant* All right, you stay down!
You eat shit!
Hey, check it out, Ryota got busted.
What a fuck-up.
Ha, told you. I win, pay up.
Huh? Masa-san, what're you talking abou⑬
Okay, Yusuke, your turn.
I won't fuck it up like Ryota.
Wait! Masa-san! Help me!
I only did it because you told me to, Masa-san...
I don't associate with fuck-ups, loser. Come on, let's go.
Hey, are you two with him? You're not going anywhere!
What's that, fucker?
Haha! This drunk's a wimp!
Bwahahaha!
*groan*
Araseki-han! You all right?
Could I be any more pathetic? Lost my dream, pushed around by a couple of punks...
I should've realized. I was never man enough for this job.
Haha! Get a load of this! The old drunk's knocked on his ass, crying about lost dreams!
I can't believe it, haha! How do you get to be that old without facing up to being the loser you are? I'm embarrassed for you, old man, real talk.
Glad I won't ever grow up to be like you, man.
Okay, let's boogie on out.
Hold it.
Why're ya doin' this sorta thing?
I don't know who you are, but I'll kick your ass.
Ya steal outta boredom, ya leave your mate behind... What are ya tryin' to do?
What's that now?
What's the goal here? The dream?
Dream? Do I look like a fucking girl? Everything's cool if I'm having fun now. Who gives a shit about the future?
Guess that answers that.
Life ain't all milk and honey, ya know. No guarantee of success.
I know it 'cause I'm just like Araseki-han. I chased a dream, and I failed... Just days ago.
But, that joy of fulfillin' a dream... If you want a chance at feelin' it, you gotta have a dream in the first place.
You got nothin' like that. You got no right to mock those who do.
It's worth aspiring to be somethin'. Don't matter how many times you come up short!
(He really believes what he's saying...)
You lecturing me now? Get off your soapbox, fucker.
Yo, let's shut him up.
Yeah, I'm gonna enjoy it!
Hoowaah, it's c-c-cold! Where'm I?
Argh, I was asleep? Sorry about that.
You're kind of a handful, aren't ya.
Hehe, sorry. I wish I had an excuse.
Someone, help! Purse snatcher!
(Where the hell is he goin'!)
Araseki-han!
(Ugh, now I gotta chase him!)
(Hey, it's those girls again.)

Phew, I can't eat another bite. But I wonder if that
PrintCircle rumor was really just BS. Wanna try it again?

You're still goin' on about that? I guess we did quit after
only one try.

(They're still going on about it. I suppose I should fill
them in.)
Uh, pardon me, ladies. Did I hear you say something about a cursed PrintCircle?
What do you want, pops?
Ooh, the disheveled look. Can't say I disapprove.

Huh? Sachi, really? You're into that? I way prefer
Nonomiya-kun.

What was that you were sayin'? Somethin' about the cursed
PrintCircle? Ain't ya kinda old to be showin' an interest in
ghost stories?
Totally. Super childish. But yeah, have a look at this. See?

Oh yeah, that's him. The whole cursed PrintCircle thing was
some guy pulling a prank.

Oh, hey, he doesn't have the mask yet. This must be from
when he was just starting.

I chased him down just now. Man, he was fast. Still, I
managed to collar him, and he seemed pretty sorry. I doubt
he'll be doing this again.
What? What's with the looks?
What're ya talkin' about, dude?
This guy died three years ago.

He was always photobombin' people in that PrintCircle. One
day, someone got pissed and chased him all over town.

Poor guy ran out into the street without noticin' a red
light, and well... That was that.

Ever since, he's been photobombin' that PrintCircle from
beyond the grave, or so people say. So whaddya mean ya met
the guy?
Wait...

Ahahaha! Were you tryin' to pick us up with that lame story?
That's adorable! A for effort!

Oh, is that what this is about? Nice one, but I prefer when
guys take the direct approach! No smooth moves for me.
This was fun, though! Byeee!
(Was that guy just a look-alike? Or maybe...)

You know that PrintCircle machine at Club SEGA? They say a
ghost sometimes appears in the photos!
Huh? Whaddya mean, "a ghost"?

I dunno. Heard about it in class. They call it "the cursed
PrintCircle." We gotta go check it out.
Huh... It's probably gonna be scary, but you wanna go?
("Cursed PrintCircle," huh? Might be worth checking out.)
...Man, I'm beat. So, anyway, what's your deal?

I'm sorry! Wait a second, I've been through something like
this before...
